notes: Published title 'This Drug Deal is gettin worse all the time' is a drug joke (the strategy also jokes about selling pot to the opponent), so the page uses the player name; the published title stays in the source citation.

Starting cards as posted under 'Startin7': This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (posted 'TDIGWATT/PIDAIAF'), Cloud City: Upper Walkway, Secret Plans, Prepared Defenses (posted 'Prep.Def.'), Crush The Rebellion, I'm Sorry and '(Other Depends)'; these count toward the 60. The '(Other Depends)' line is the seventh starting card, Imperial Arrest Order or Resistance from the Effects section ('one of 2 you will start'; the strategy says start Resistance against EBO, otherwise IAO), so it is not a separate row. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so no starting Effect is set.
Section counts as posted: 7 + 5 + 23 + 4 + 6 + 10 + 5 = 60, but 'Fast Red10' names only 9 interrupts, so the list totals 59 as published.

Posted 'Darth Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine) and 'Mauls stabber' Maul's Lightsaber; 'Maras dildo' dested Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Vaders magical flash light' (weapons section) dested Vader's Lightsaber; 'Empy Palpy' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'Booby Fett w/Gun' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Bossk w/Gun' dested Bossk With Mortar Gun; '4-LOM w/Gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Dr.E&PB' dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'GAT' dested Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'Exwifecutor' dested Executor; 'Zuckuss inMH' / 'Dengar inPO' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter / Dengar In Punishing One (same choices as his DeckTech 16834).

Posted 'Force Zapper' (interrupts section) dested Force Lightning, the Emperor's Force lightning interrupt (his 16834 list plays Force Lightning); 'Ev.&Mon.' dested Evader & Monnok; 'Twelek Ad.' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'I had no FU(KIN CHOICE' dested the Cloud City Effect I Had No Choice; 'SaD' dested Search And Destroy; 'CCDB' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay).

Two-sided generic cards dested the Dark pages: Bespin (Dark), Bespin: Cloud City (Dark), Cloud City: Chasm Walkway (Dark), Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber (Dark), Vibro-Ax (Dark). Secret Plans and Resistance are 2001 Effects, counted in the 60.
Posted 8 June 2001; no Coruscant-set cards are listed, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
